source: libdev.dll static initializers (MSVC global ctors), dumped via Ghidra 12.1.4 pseudo-code 2026-11-06
notes: Pairs decoded from packed u64 immediates: low u32 = key, high u32 = value.
These are REMAP/override tables for the network protocol sets, not the full command namespace.

cmd_set 0 (local USB control) is NOT in the outer map: header wire-cmd falls back to sentinel 0x0FFF, and the true cmd_id (u16) travels at the start of the payload instead (verified: gimbal-preset request cmd_id 0x3B=59 appears as payload bytes 3B 00 03 00).
Byte 9 nibble map is used twice in the frame header: low nibble = f(internal[5]), high nibble = f(internal[6]) - protocol/version nibble encoding.
setcode map feeds the top 4 bits of wire word 10 (cmd_set -> setcode); set 0 -> 0.
Inner map hit = translation app-cmd-id -> wirecode for remote/app protocol sets (1,2,3,5: BLE/KCP/app/cloud). Miss in set 0 is normal and means passthrough-with-payload-header.
frame_header_review: off0=0xAA; off1..2=len&0xFFF; off3=flags(type|0x10); off4..5=seq; off6..8=0; off9=nibble(version); off10..11=wirecode&0xFFF | setcode<<12; off12+=payload

outer_cmdset_to_inner.fallback: set not present (incl. set 0 = local USB): wirecode = 0xFFF sentinel; real cmd_id in payload u16[0]

key_functions.FUN_180100450: Plain frame encoder (consumes all maps above)
key_functions.FUN_180007490: sendMsgSync engine: seq alloc, pending list, 1s timeout, 1 resend
